source_snapshot.items: Test connections between FPGA1 and HMC I2C-2
source_snapshot.procedure: On HMC run `i2ctransfer -y 3 w2@0x11 0x04 0x00 r3`; refer to PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect results/photos and confirm no unexpected logs; no reply oracle is supplied.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; substitutes physical probing/soldering for the explicit HMC transaction.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Flags raw-write semantics but incorrectly retains a physical-only interpretation and risks same-code row155 confusion.

old_problem: HMC I2C-2-to-bus3 mapping,0x11 FPGA1 identity,0x0400 non-mutating pointer semantics, expected three-byte decoder, bus ownership, error limits and recovery are absent; prior reviews invent physical probing and the code is duplicated at row155.
disposition_reason: The supplied HMC combined read can verify functional communication and is not Manual Only. ED-02/03 require row131 variant identity plus authoritative OEM mapping, register semantics and decoded expectations before access; these cannot be inferred from an ACK or the unrelated same-code SEL row.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row131, same-row AI fields and history2521; row155 with the same code was excluded by source row/hash/variant.
Preserved HMC execution, bus3,0x11,0x0400,r3, FPGA1 and HMC I2C-2 coverage.
Replaced invented probe/solder work with one gated functional transaction and path-specific telemetry.
Required one bounded request with first-failure preservation; no scan, retry, reset, probe or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: HMC I2C-2 bus3 to FPGA1 functional register read
test_case.purpose: Prove functional communication from HMC I2C-2 to FPGA1 on the approved HMC bus3 path using a decoded, non-mutating register0x0400 read.
required_package: PID1114953 mapping of HMC I2C-2 to bus3 and FPGA1 to0x11
FPGA1 revision-specific0x0400 definition and three-byte expected mask/value decoder
Proof the two-byte write only selects a read pointer
HMC bus3 owner/exclusive-access window, timeout/NACK criteria and recovery
test_case.test_command: After identity/protocol approval, capture HMC/FPGA1 identity, bus owner and error baseline; run exactly one `i2ctransfer -y 3 w2@0x11 0x04 0x00 r3`; record status/latency, decode all three bytes against the signed oracle, correlate path counters, and do not retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The approved transaction returns exactly three bytes matching the FPGA1 register oracle, HMC I2C-2 and FPGA1 telemetry show the intended path with no new error, and management remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires variant-bound topology,0x11 identity, decoded expected fields and clean path telemetry. ACK/arbitrary bytes, wrong length/value, NACK/timeout/arbitration loss, missing identity, use of row155 evidence or new errors fails; photos document evidence but do not replace the oracle.
safety_gate: Confirm bus3/0x11/0x0400 for the installed FPGA1 revision before raw access.
Coordinate with the HMC driver/daemon; do not force or concurrently access the bus.
One bounded read only; stop on the first error without retry/reset.
Do not probe/solder or substitute BMC bus2, HMC bus0 or same-code row155 evidence.
expected_evidence: Row131 variant identity and PID bus3/FPGA1 map
Timestamped command, stdout/stderr, exit status, latency and decoded matrix
Pre/post path counters/logs, management health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected after approved pointer/read semantics. Preserve first-failure evidence and stop; use only the pre-approved HMC/FPGA recovery path if health degrades.

source_conflict.reason: Source lacks mapping, target/register identity and reply oracle; earlier reviews add unsourced physical probing and duplicate-code ambiguity.

blocked.reason: The functional operation is identifiable; project mapping, decoder, access controls and recovery are obtainable RPUC inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: PID bus3 path, FPGA1/0x11 identity,0x0400 safety/decoder, ownership, deterministic error oracle and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the variant-bound bus/register protocol, decoded expectation and controlled recovery, then issue a versioned review-layer revision.

project_authority: PID1114953 and the installed FPGA1/HMC vendor register specifications control the OEM mapping and response semantics.
